articles.author: Radhika Anilkumar Nadig
articles.headline: Ross Gerber Slams 'Bubble Talk' as Earnings Season Begins: 'AI Is No Fad' and 'Valuations Are Quite Nice'
articles.summary: Ross Gerber urged investors to look past the tech selloff, dismissing AI bubble fears and calling the sector a long-term opportunity.
articles._summary: Ross Gerber of investment firm Gerber Kawasaki told investors to look past the recent technology selloff on Thursday, dismissing fears of an AI bubble, saying the sector remained a long-term opportunity. In a post on X, Gerber said stocks were in “sell mode” just as earnings season got underway, with investors raising doubts about valuations after the recent pullback. Gerber dismissed concerns that the weakness reflected an AI bubble, saying there was “no bubble talk” despite growing skepticism around the sector.
articles._zh_headline: 财报季开始之际，罗斯·格伯 (Ross Gerber) 猛烈抨击“泡沫言论”：“人工智能并非时尚”且“估值相当不错”
articles._zh_summary: 周四，投资公司格柏川崎 (Gerber Kawasaki) 的罗斯·格柏 (Ross Gerber) 告诉投资者，不要忽视最近的科技股抛售，他消除了对人工智能泡沫的担忧，称该行业仍然是一个长期机会。格伯在 X 上发表的一篇文章中表示，就在财报季节开始之际，股票正处于“卖出模式”，投资者在最近的回调后对估值提出了怀疑。格伯驳斥了有关疲软反映人工智能泡沫的担忧，称尽管对该行业的怀疑与日俱增，但“没有泡沫言论”。

articles.author: Namrata Sen
articles.headline: Xi Jinping Rejects AI 'Solo Performance' by One Country as China's Kimi K3 Lands to Challenge OpenAI, Anthropic
articles.summary: Xi Jinping calls for global AI cooperation at WAIC 2026, pledging support for developing nations and responsible AI growth.
articles._summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping spoke at the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC) on Friday, highlighting the need for international cooperation in AI development. Xi voiced China’s readiness to pursue greater openness and practical action in AI development. He stressed the importance of international cooperation, stating that AI development should not be a “solo performance” by a single country, but a “symphony of global collaboration,” the South China Morning Post reported.
articles._zh_headline: 习近平拒绝一国人工智能“独奏”，中国Kimi K3登陆挑战OpenAI、Anthropic
articles._zh_summary: 中国国家主席习近平周五在 2026 年世界人工智能大会 (WAIC) 上发表讲话，强调人工智能开发领域国际合作的必要性。习近平表示，中国愿在人工智能发展方面采取更加开放的态度和实际行动。据《南华早报》报道，他强调了国际合作的重要性，并表示人工智能发展不应是单个国家的“独奏”，而应是“全球合作的交响乐”。

articles.author: Ananya Gairola
articles.headline: Sundar Pichai Says 'Great' to see Intel Using Gemini Enterprise as Chipmaker Expands Google Cloud Partnership for AI-Powered Chip Design
articles.summary: Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai praised Intel's Gemini Enterprise rollout as the chipmaker expanded its Google Cloud AI partnership.
articles._summary: Reacting to the announcement on X , Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai wrote, “Great to see @Intel using Gemini Enterprise across its business, including to speed up the development of next-gen semiconductors!” Under the expanded agreement, Intel will deploy Gemini Enterprise as a centralized AI platform for employees, enabling teams to build and use AI agents for coding, engineering automation and other business workflows.
articles._zh_headline: Sundar Pichai 表示“很高兴”看到英特尔使用 Gemini Enterprise 作为芯片制造商扩大谷歌云合作伙伴关系以实现人工智能驱动的芯片设计
articles._zh_summary: Alphabet 首席执行官 Sundar Pichai 在回应 X 上的公告时写道：“很高兴看到 @Intel 在其业务中使用 Gemini Enterprise，包括加快下一代半导体的开发！”根据扩展协议，英特尔将部署 Gemini Enterprise 作为员工的集中式人工智能平台，使团队能够构建和使用人工智能代理进行编码、工程自动化和其他业务工作流程。

articles.author: Aniket Verma
articles.headline: SpaceX Stock to Close Higher by July End? Probability on Crypto Prediction Market Falls From 61% to 32%
articles.summary: Cryptocurrency bettors are increasingly expecting Space Exploration Technologies Corp. to close lower by the end of July, as the stock continues to trade below its IPO price amid renewed selling pressure.
articles._summary: Cryptocurrency bettors are increasingly expecting Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (NASDAQ: SPCX ) to close lower by the end of July, as the stock continues to trade below its IPO price amid renewed selling pressure. The probability of SPCX closing higher has dropped sharply from 61% last week to 32% at the time of writing. Note that SPCX finished at $170.86 on June 30. For an “Up” resolution, the stock must equal or beat $170.86 by the market close on July 31.
articles._zh_headline: SpaceX 股价将在 7 月底收高？加密货币预测市场的概率从 61% 下降至 32%
articles._zh_summary: 加密货币押注者越来越多地预计 Space Exploration Technologies Corp.（纳斯达克股票代码：SPCX）将在 7 月底收盘走低，因为该股在新的抛售压力下继续低于其 IPO 价格。 SPCX 收高的概率已从上周的 61% 大幅下降至撰写本文时的 32%。请注意，SPCX 6 月 30 日收盘价为 170.86 美元。对于“上涨”决议，该股票必须在 7 月 31 日收盘时等于或高于 170.86 美元。

articles.author: Piero Cingari
articles.headline: SanDisk's 40% Drop From Peak: Value Trap or Once-in-a-Generation Buy?
articles.summary: SanDisk trades at 7.9x forward earnings after a 40% drop. History says memory stocks look cheapest right before earnings break.
articles._summary: Two investors can look at the same number — 7.9 times earnings — and reach opposite conclusions. One sees the cheapest SanDisk Corp. (NASDAQ: SNDK ) has ever been. The other sees the oldest trap in semiconductors. As of Thursday, July 16, SanDisk sits 39.1% below the record of $2,351.37 it set in late June, and its forward price-to-earnings ratio — the share price divided by what analysts expect the company to earn over the next twelve months, a rough measure of how expensive a stock is — has fallen to 7.9x.
articles._zh_headline: SanDisk 股价较峰值下跌 40%：价值陷阱还是千载难逢的买入机会？
articles._zh_summary: 两个投资者可以看到相同的数字（市盈率 7.9 倍）并得出相反的结论。人们看到了闪迪公司（纳斯达克股票代码：SNDK）有史以来最便宜的价格。另一个看到了半导体中最古老的陷阱。截至 7 月 16 日星期四，SanDisk 的股价比 6 月底创下的 2,351.37 美元的纪录低了 39.1%，其预期市盈率（股价除以分析师预计该公司未来 12 个月的盈利，粗略衡量股票价格的指标）已降至 7.9 倍。

articles.author: Chris Katje
articles.headline: X-Energy Stock: Nuclear Company Becomes Cathie Wood’s New Favorite Position

articles._summary: Ark Invest, led by Cathie Wood , has been building big positions in a new IPO across three ETFs. articles._zh_summary: 由 Cathie Wood 领导的 Ark Invest 一直在三只 ETF 的新 IPO 中建立大量头寸。虽然 Ark Invest 正在购买最近 IPO 的 SpaceX 的股票，但这是另一个名字，购买时间可以追溯到 2026 年 4 月。该股开盘价为 30.11 美元，收盘价为 29.20 美元。不算最近的周末（7月11日、7月12日），Ark Invest已连续四个交易日将XE股票添加到三只ETF中。
